decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offset intervals identified in N/E/U: (365–375) and (410–415), both showing multi-axis transient offsets without confirmed full returns within allowed context [365,579]. Neither exhibits a sustained flat interior nor a clean opposing return; recoveries are partial and noisy. No other intervals meet criteria for confirmed temporary offset.

intervals.observation: N shows a multi-sample drop (365–375); E and U exhibit correlated transient offsets in same window; no clear return observed before 376, and interior is not sustained flat—only a brief dip with noisy recovery. Return ambiguous.

N shows second abrupt drop (410–415) after plateau; E and U show concurrent transient offsets; partial recovery begins after 415 but does not reach pre-drop level by 420, and no full return observed within allowed context. Sustained interior absent; return unconfirmed.
